name: Read
prose: Absolute paths only. cat -n output with a 2000-line window and a continuation offset. Images go to the vision endpoint and come back as a description, or are refused. Documents (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/RTF/ODT/EPUB) are text-extracted under a 20MB cap. A NUL byte in the first 8KB means binary — refused honestly rather than returned as mojibake.
invariant: Read returns line-numbered text, refuses a directory/missing/binary file with a distinct explanatory error, extracts documents, and never hands an image to the coding model.
